reserveReview.rationale: USD.AI's March 26, 2026 upgrade states that every USDai is backed 1:1 by PYUSD. At Arbitrum block 483800206, baseToken() returned canonical PYUSD; canonical totalSupply plus bridgedSupply was 196,394,460.208802187811855903 USDai, while the hub held 196,394,460.221193 PYUSD. The small surplus reconciles the complete base-token liability. USD.AI separately assigns GPU-loan yield exposure to sUSDai, so DEAL rows are not attributed to base USDai.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer disclosure plus fixed-block canonical and bridged liability reconciliation against the hub's PYUSD balance
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unidentified base-USDai reserve exposure remained in the fixed-block liability reconciliation. This conclusion does not classify the separate sUSDai strategy portfolio.
